headings.title: License application, surety bonds, and bond cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1973 S.B. 28 § 3). Covers application submission on director-adopted forms, $10,000 corporate surety bond plus $1,000 separate bond per employee engaged as public adjuster or solicitor conditioned on settlement-fund accounting under §§ 325.010–325.055, aggregate liability cap, and surety cancellation upon 30 days' notice relieving liability for subsequent breaches. headings.title: Initial application fee, annual renewal, and termination
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1973 S.B. 28 § 4, A.L. 1990 H.B. 1739). headings.title: Property owner's three-business-day cancellation right
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1973 S.B. 28 § 9). Grants the owner of damaged property the right to cancel an agreement with a licensed public adjuster or solicitor until midnight of the third business day after the day of signing. Reviewer re-read the full subsection, subdivisions and continuations against the archived text; title confirmed accurate.

headings.title: Cancellation notice procedure and owner liability exception
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note (L. 1973 S.B. 28 § 9). Specifies written cancellation notice delivered or mailed postage prepaid to the agreement address containing written intent to cancel, and relieves the owner of liability upon timely cancellation except for reasonable expenses incurred in preserving the damaged premises during the three-day period. Reviewer re-read the full subsection, subdivisions and continuations against the archived text; title confirmed accurate.
